segments.text: For your shoulder, start the wall stretch I showed you.
Hold it for 20 seconds, 3 times, once a day in the morning.
A bit of discomfort is normal, but it should not hurt.
Do not lift anything heavy over your head for now.
If you feel numbness in your hand, call the practice straight away.
